reviews.title: Motherboard was defective, "Amazon Renewed" didn't find the defects. Angry at Amazon
reviews.comment: I had to reseat the RAM multiple times before all my RAM was recognized. But eventually the 4th slot worked. At first I used the stock Ryzen heatsink and everything seemed to work except Windows was giving errors on PCIe devices. I installed a tower CPU cooler because the stock cooler wasn't keeping up and the computer crashed hard and cleared the BIOS. The computer was even crashing in UEFI/BIOS setup (Amazon support somehow thought that was a Windows problem). The computer could only boot on its side and even then the 4th RAM slot wasn't showing its RAM (Amazon support suggested I just keep my PC on its side). With a new motherboard everything worked without errors - except my Windows and MS Office licenses were deactivated and I had a hard time getting them activated again.
reviews.author: Neevix
